content.title: About Zignaly
content.description: Zignaly is a social crypto investment platform. It allows users to invest in crypto by using signals, copying experts, or fully delegated mode with profit sharing (PAMM), eliminating the need for monthly subscriptions. Instead, users pay only a portion of their profit as a success fee.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: What is UNI?
content.description: UNI is the governance token for Uniswap. UNI was introduced on 16th September 2020 through a retrospective airdrop to users who have interacted with the protocol either by swapping tokens or by providing liquidity.

content.title: About Bless (BLESS)
content.description: Bless is a decentralized computing platform designed to transform the idle processing power of everyday consumer devices into a global, shared supercomputer.

content.title: About Heima (HEI)
content.description: Heima is a chain abstraction and account abstraction protocol designed to simplify cross-chain interactions and decentralized finance (DeFi) by removing technical fragmentation.

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About Venice Token (VVV)
content.description: Venice Token (VVV) is the utility and capital asset of the Venice AI platform, a privacy-focused generative artificial intelligence network built on the Base blockchain.

content.title: About Solana (SOL)
content.description: Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built for mass adoption, offering a fast and low-cost environment for decentralized applications.

content.title: About Ethereum
content.description: Ethereum is a blockchain platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications, operating through thousands of independent nodes worldwide rather than through a central authority.

content.title: About Sui (SUI)
content.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for global adoption by providing a high-speed and secure environment for digital asset ownership.
